title: Japan ahead.
intro: A simpler fuel stop, in a language you know. For your next drive through Japan.
notice: Fuel search is ready to try. Rental return, vehicle fuel matching and refuelling guides are coming later.
section: What will you need on the road?
findBody: A nearby stop for the road ahead.
returnBody: Make the last fuel stop a little easier.
fuelTitle: What fuel does my car need?
fuelBody: Know what to check before you fill up.
helpBody: Make sense of the signs at the pump.
promiseBody: If we don’t know, we’ll say so. No guessed fuel types or prices presented as live.
privacy: Location is requested only after you press “Use my location”. No precise-location storage or analytics transmission.
sourcesBody: Stations come from OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik. Official prefectural fuel references come from Japan’s Agency for Natural Resources and Energy. Source dates and unknowns are shown; no live station prices or vehicle-fuel guesses.
footer: Made for the journey, wherever it takes you.
pageTitle: Fuel Me Japan — Refuel with confidence
description: Find fuel stations in Japan in five languages. Explicit location search or prefecture selection, honest unknowns and dated official prefectural reference prices.
ffNoJavaScript: Enable JavaScript to search for stations. You can still read this page and switch languages.
ffIntro: Find mapped fuel stations in Japan. Use your location, or choose a prefecture without sharing it.
ffLocationPrivacy: Only requested when you press this button. Kept in this panel’s memory; not saved or sent to analytics.
ffManualHelp: All 47 prefectures. No location permission needed.
ffStart: Choose how you’d like to find a station.
ffLocating: Waiting for your device’s location… You can choose a prefecture instead.
ffLoading: Loading and checking regional station data…
ffDenied: Location permission was denied. Choose a prefecture, or enable location in your browser and try again.
ffUnavailable: Your device’s location is unavailable. Choose a prefecture or try the location button again.
ffTimeout: Location took too long. Choose a prefecture or try the location button again.
ffOutside: This location is outside our Japan search area. Choose a Japanese prefecture to plan a stop.
ffLoadError: Station data could not be loaded or verified. Retry, choose another prefecture, or search an external map.
ffFilter: Filter by recorded name, city or address
ffFilterPlaceholder: Try a Japanese station name or city
ffFilterHelp: Searches only this list’s recorded tags. Missing names and addresses cannot be matched; this is not a place geocoder.
ffStraightLineHelp: Sorted by straight-line distance within 50 km. This is not driving distance or travel time; roads and access may differ.
ffNoDistance: Showing this prefecture’s mapped stations. Your location is not used, so no distance from you is shown.
ffNoResults: No matching station in this dataset. This does not mean there are no stations. Change your selection or try an external map.
ffMapHelp: Opens a new tab only when you choose a link. The map provider may ask for its own location permission. We do not pass your device’s coordinates.
ffCoverage: OpenStreetMap station data, distributed via Geofabrik. Coverage and details may be incomplete or outdated; confirm at the station.
ffHoursHelp: Hours are raw OpenStreetMap tags, not a live “open now” check. Unknown means the source does not confirm it.
ffFuelReminderTitle: Your vehicle’s fuel is not verified
ffFuelReminder: Check your rental documents and the vehicle’s fuel-door label before filling. Ask the rental company if unsure. A station’s fuel list does not identify what your car needs.
ffPaymentHelp: A recorded card brand does not guarantee acceptance of foreign-issued cards. Check with the station before filling.
ffPriceScope: A prefectural benchmark, not this station’s price or a live quote.
ffPriceUnit: Cash survey prices · tax included · JPY per litre
ffPriceError: Official reference prices could not be verified. Station search and navigation are still available.
ffStalePrice: Older reference: the survey is more than 14 days old. Check the source date and confirm prices at the station.
ffOfficialSource: Source: Agency for Natural Resources and Energy / METI — original survey workbook ↗
ffProcessed: Processed from the official survey: prefectural rows and three fuel categories extracted. This presentation is not government-endorsed.
ffNavigationHelp: Opens an external map in a new tab. Only the station destination is passed; the provider handles your route and location permission.
